Commentary.Commentary: Number 10 for the Aussies in terms of points! They get back their pole position. Still, no one is qualified for the semis officially, while no one is out. On Wednesday, New Zealand topped the table. Thursday, it was done by the Aussies. Come Friday, England will look to win the musical chairs round by beating Sri Lanka. Do we have a surprise in store? Join us on June 21, 2019 at 10.30 am local (0930 GMT) at Headingley, Leeds. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious Australian captain, Aaron Finch, is not quite fussed about being nervous during the Mahmudullah-Rahim stand and says that there is plenty of experience in the Aussie bowling to finish things off. On his partnership with Warner, Finch says that both of them are pretty much experienced and know how to go about things. Admits that they missed Stoinis a lot in the last 2 games and today he was welcome. On the possibility of 2 spinners in the side, Finch says that it depends on the track and also about the balance of the side. Admits that the fielding was very sloppy today. With one leg almost in the semi-final, Aaron says that the Aussies would like to have one more win and consolidate that spot. On his own batting form, Finch says that as an opening batsman, once you get a couple of boundaries, you are on your way to getting confidence.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza, says that had the target been 40 runs lesser, the mindset of the Bangladesh batsmen would have been different. Praises his batters though and credits the Aussies for piling on a huge total. On the current squad, Mash says that they have the best team that they can possibly put together. On the run chase, Mortaza says that big partnerships were needed but even then, admits that 381 was a bit too much. Sadly says that he can only focus on winning his own games and hoping that some other teams lose above Bangladesh.

DAVID WARNER HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH. On his 16th ODI hundred, being par with Adam Gilchrist, Warner says that it is a great achievement but is happier with the 2 points. On his and Finch's newly found approach, David says that it is all about respecting the new balls and then opening up and target the secondary bowlers. Adds that one needs to adapt to the conditions and then play according to the situation. On the pitch, Warner says that the pitch was a tad slow and a grind for the bowlers. Ends the conversation with a smile, saying that he will continue trying his best to get the big scores.

Not a great reading for the Aussie bowlers. This was a game where they had plenty of cushion with the score reading 381 but barring Starc, no one bowled well. On a track which had nothing for the bowlers, everyone suffered, not quite doing that well. A worrying sign, with the business end approaching. Australia have 10 points from 5 wins but none of those 5 have quite seen a complete performance yet. Please stay tuned for the presentation...

The brothers-in-law, Rahim and Mahmudullah then decided to have some fun. They teed off, punishing all the Aussie bowlers and added 127 for the 5th wicket but in the end, the task was too much to do. Rahim got to his century but today, when Shakib was needed to score big, could not quite get a big one.

When a team is chasing 382, it needs a solid and a quickfire opening stand. Bangladesh could not get that. Sarkar was dismissed early and after that, even though Shakib and Tamim revived the innings, that stand seemed a bit slow and was always behind the 8-ball. The acceleration never really came till Liton Das joined forces with Mushfiqur Rahim.

Comprehensive win for Australia but Bangladesh fought hard. Had the target been around 350, they might have very well chased it. The Aussies might have ironed out their batting issues but the bowling still needs a lot of working over.

OUT! Caught. A wicket to end the game. A short ball, outside off, Mortaza pulls it away but it is only as long as deep mid-wicket. Glenn Maxwell runs to his right and completes the formalities. AUSTRALIA WIN BY 48 RUNS.
A low full toss outside off, flicked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on the off stump, pushed towards point for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot. Full and in the slot, outside off, Mashrafe gets under it and bashes it out over the bowler for a boundary down the ground.
Outside off, a wild heave but a miss.
On middle, tucked to the leg side for a single.
HUNDRED FOR RAHIM! Well played. What a knock. Fighting hard with the chips down. Gets there with a gentle push through the covers. Starc is done - 10-0-55-2.
Around off, solidly defended.
99...Mushfiqur. No field changes from Finch. Shouldn't the fielders come in?
A terrific yorker, Mortaza somehow gets his bat down in time and ekes out a thick outside edge to third man for one.
99. Full and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
In comes the skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza, for the final rites. He will be at the non-striker's end as the batsmen crossed.

OUT! Caught. Starc gets another tail-ender. This is a quick one, 145 kph, in line of the stumps, Mehedi backs away to the leg side and looks to chip this over the on side but only mistimes it straight to mid on. Easy catch for David Warner and Starc has his second.
Yorker on the stumps, dug out towards point for a single. Moves to 98.
Yorker on off, squeezed behind point for a single to keep the strike.
A slower bouncer, outside off, MR looks to play the upper cut but misses.
FOUR! A bit lucky, for Rahim and he will take that. A hit away from a century now. Outside off, Mushfiqur has a poke at it but gets a thick outside edge, wide of Carey to the third man fence.
Full and around off, Rahim works it through square leg, Mitchell Starc gives it a good chase from fine leg and dives, stopping the ball cleanly. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Just over! Full and outside off, Rahim backs away and hits it hard. Just about clears a leaping Aaron Finch at mid off. Moves to 90. That is the only point of interest left in this game now.
Short and outside off, slapped through point for a single.
Marcus Stoinis to bowl the 48th over. 6-0-35-1 so far.
Excellent over. Just 6 off this one. Back of a length on off, Mehedi hits it over the bowler's head and gets just a single.

Full on middle and leg, Mehedi strokes it towards mid on. Mushfiqur wanted a single but Hasan says no. Warner has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Replays shows had he hit it would not have made a difference as Rahim was in.
Back of a length ball outside off, Mehedi lofts it over point and gets a  couple.
Very full outside off, Mehedi guides it to backward point for a single.
Full once again on off, Mehedi plays it towards covber and gets to the other end.
Fuller on off, Mushfiqur strokes it to cover and gets a single.
Mitchell Starc is back.
Single to end the over. A brilliant over from Coulter-Nile. 4 runs and 2 wickets off this one. The last ball is short, Mushfiqur pulls it to deep mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Mehedi does well to deal with the hat-trick ball. Good length ball on middle, Mehedi tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets one.
Mehedi Hasan comes out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Two in two. Coulter-Nile on a hat-trick now. Good length ball outside off, and for some reason Sabbir was trying to run it down towards third man. The required run-rate is well over 12 but he still goes for this shot. He ends up getting an inside edge which goes onto hit the stumps. In a matter of two balls all the Bangladeshi hearts are broken.
Sabbir Rahman walks in at number 7, replacing Mahmudullah. All is not lost yet. One big over, in the 20s, can still even this contest.

OUT! Coulter-Nile gives Australia the big breakthrough and maybe that is the final nail in the coffin for Bangladesh in this chase. Coulter-Nile bangs it in short, Mahmudullah goes for the pull. It makes sweet sound off the bat but he does not time it well and it goes straight to Cummins at deep mid-wicket. The crowd is dejected. Mahmudullah did give some hope but could not quite fulfill the needs. End of a magnificent innings though.

In the air but safe. Good length ball outside off, Mahmudullah looks to hit it over long on. It does not come off the middle. It goes towards long on. The ball falls short of Starc who lost it in the sun as he dived but was nowhere close.
Smartly bowled. Slower one outside off, Mahmudullah comes down the track and looks to flat bat it over long off but misses.
Length ball on the body, Mahmudullah flicks it towards mid-wicket and keeps the strike. 51 runs have come off the last 4.
SIX! Oh, that is a monster. Overpitched on off, Mahmudullah smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a huge six.
Good length balll on off, Mushfiqur runs it down to third man for one. Singles won't hurt Australia.
Fuller on off, Mahmudullah plays a good looking loft shot over covers. There is a man in the deep so just one.
In the air...but short. Cummins bangs it in short. Rahim does not time his pull. It works in his favour as it falls short of Coulter-Nile at deep mid-wicket. A run taken.
Good length ball on middle, Mahmudullah comes down the track and hits it towards mid-wicket. There is a man in the deep there so just a single.
Mahmudullah will keep the strike. On the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it to the on side and gets a single. 93 needed off the last 6 overs.
FOUR! This is better for Bangladesh. A low full toss on middle, Nathan Coulter-Nile expects Mahmudullah to go straight but he hits it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Fifty for Mahmudullah! He is going to fight till the end here. Full outside off, Mahmudullah squeezes it past point for a boundary to bring up his 21st ODI fifty.
Short on off, Rahim pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets just a solitary run. Bangladesh need sixes and fours here.
Slower ball on a length. It is on middle Mahmudullah turns it towards 45 on the leg side and takes one.
Good length ball on off, Mushfiqur plays it towards cover and gets one.
Nathan Coulter-Nile back into the attack. 8-0-42-0 so far.
Outside off, Mushfiqur guides it down to third man and keeps the strike. 13 off that Cummins over.
Outside off on a length, Mahmudullah runs it down to third man for a single.

WIDE! Another one in this over. Cummins is all over the place in this over. Yorker outside off. It is on the wrong side of the tramline and Kettleborough has to stretch out his arms. 100-run stand comes up between the two.
Full again on middle, this time Rahim flicks it towards deep mid-wicket. Gets just a single.
Very full on middle and off, Mahmudullah flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets one. This is better from Cummins. 9 off the over so far.
Good length ball on off, Mushfiqur strokes it towards cover and gets to the other end.
WIDE! This time bowls it outside the tramline on the off side and Rahim misses his cut. Wide given by the umpire.
WIDE AND FOUR! Slower bouncer bounces too high. Rahim goes after it but misses. The ball pitches in front of Carey and then spins away from him. He misses it and the ball goes to the fine leg fence.
Slower ball on middle, Mahmudullah turns it towards square leg and gets a single.
Pat Cummins is back on. 8-1-41-0 so far.
Mahmudullah will keep the strike. Tossed up on off, Mahmudullah taps it towards mid off and takes a quick run. 15 from the over, Zampa's figures read 9-0-68-1!
SIX! Wrong 'un goes wrong! Zampa lands it in Mahmudullah's zone, he takes the full toll of it and heaves it over mid-wicket for a 91m biggie.
Follows that up with a solid front foot defense.
SIX! That one is out of here. Tossed up on middle, Mahmudullah comes down the track and heaves it over the bowler's head for a  95m maximum.
Tossed up on off, Mahmudullah  hits it wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Quick and short outside off, Mahmudullah looks to cut but misses.
Good length ball on top of middle and leg, Rahim looks to play the paddle but misses. Just 4 off the over.
Full on off, Mahmudullah hits it towards deep mid-wicket and gets a run.
YORKER! A perfect one on middle and leg. Stoinis executes it brilliantly. Mahmudullah does well to get his bat down in time.
Full outside off, Mushfiqur chips it wide of sweeper cover and gets to the other end.
On middle, Mahmudullah flicks it towards deep square leg and gets a single.
Full on the pads, Mushfiqur looks to heave it but misses. The ball lobs off his pads towards fine leg region and they take a leg bye.
Powerplay 3 time! Now maximum of 5 fielders can be outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this game.
Zampa goes flat and outside off. Rahim tries to chop this one but fails as he gets an inside edge. Good comeback by Zampa after getting hit for a boundary on the previous delivery. 11 from the over.
FOUR! Close call for LBW! Full and straight, Mahmudullah gets down to sweep and would have been gone plumb LBW. But luckily for him, he gets a bit of a glove and it runs fine past short fine leg.
Fuller and on leg, Rahim tries to come forward and go for a slog but mistimes and ball ends up landing in front of the fielder at wide mid on.
Fuller and onto off, Rahim plays it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Nicely done. Full and outside off, Rahim gets down and plays the reverse sweep through point for a boundary!
Outside off, Flighted delivery outside off, a bit fuller. Rahim comes down the track and hits a cover drive. Maxwell at covers dives to his right and saves 2 for his side.
Adam Zampa is back into the attack. 7-0-42-1. his figures so far.
Now flicks it towards backward square leg and takes two.
Full again on the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Play and a miss. Full outside leg, Mahmudullah comes down the track and looks to hit it straight but misses it.
Full on off, MR sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Full on off, Rahim unleashes it towards mid on. Stoinis gets his right leg to it which takes the pace of the ball. The fielder from mid on cleans it up. The batsmen meanwhile come back for the second.
Full on middle and leg, Mahmudullah flicks it to square leg for a single.
Marcus Stoinis is back into the attack. He has the figures of 4-0-24-1.
Landed outside off, a play and a miss.
Starc goes for a fiery yorker, Rahim opens the face of the bat and plays it towards third man to grab a single.
FOUR! Up and over third man! A short ball outside off, Rahim waits for the ball to come and lofts it over the keeper, beating third man!
This time going down  leg, length delivery again, hits the pad as Mahmudullah misses his flick and batsmen steal a single as the ball goes rolling towards square leg.
Length delivery onto leg, Rahim flicks it towards mid-wicket and grabs a single
Steams it in on the body, Mahmadullah pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Outside off, Mushfiqur cuts it to the man at point.
Once again Cummins hits the deck hard on middle, Rahim blocks it off the back foot.
Play and a miss. Full outside off, Mushfiqur comes down the track and looks to hit it but misses.

Very well fielded from Stoinis. Back of a length ball on off, Rahim pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket. Stoinis there runs to his left and puts in a dive to stop the ball. He does so with a reverse cup and saves 2 for his side.
Good length ball on off and middle, Mushfiqur defends it towards point.
Landed outside off, played through point for a single.
Full and outside off, it is stroked towards cover for a single to end the over.
Again full, outside off and it goes past outside edge towards third man as the batsman goes for a drive. One run added to the total.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Starc goes for the yorker, bowls a bit fuller and onto middle. Mahmudullah plays it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Full and outside off, Rahim drives it wide of cover. Aaron Finch runs to his left and dives but manages to stop the ball. Just a single taken.
FOUR! Length delivery outside off, Rahim leans back and cuts it towards cover point and the ball races to the fence. Rahim welcomes Starc in fine style.
Here he comes. Mitchell Starc is back for another spell.
Short and this time Rahim pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Poor ball from Cummins! Fifty for Rahim! Cummins comes steaming in and bends his back on this one. It is on the body, Rahim flicks it fine down the leg side and it goes past the diving Carey. He gets to his 35th ODI fifty with that.
Outside off on a length, Rahim taps it to backward point.
Good length ball on the stumps, Rahim defends it towards cover and looks for a quick run but Mahmudullah says no.

Reverse swing on offer? Mitchell Starc is warming up. Looks like Finch wants another wicket here. He might not hold him back and unleash him now to give him a couple of wickets. He has been good in the latter stages of the games in this World Cup.
Back of a length ball around off, Mahmadullah taps it down to third man for single.
On the pads, Mushfiqur flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Pat Cummins on now. 6-0-36-0 so far.
FOUR! Sliced and...it beats the fielder to the fence. Short outside off, Mahmudullah slices it over point. It looks like he has not timed it well but has enough to go away to the fence.
Shows good foot movement and cuts this short ball outside off, towards backward point for a single.
Short on the body, Mushfiqur pulls it but finds short fine leg.
Loopy full toss outside off, Zampa is lucky as Mahmudullah does not take full toll of it and just creams it to sweeper cover for a single.
Straight and short outside off, Mushfiqur cuts it to point and takes a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Rahim defends it off the front foot.
Length delivery outside off, batsman goes for the cut but misses. 10 runs from the over, Bangladesh still won't be happy. They need to shift gears as soon as possible.
FOUR! Short and around off, now Mahmudullah comes down the track and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Fuller and onto middle, Rahim dances down the track and slogs it over deep mid-wicket. The ball goes on one bounce and over the ropes.
Length delivery outside off, it is worked towards third man for a single.
Good length ball on off, Mahmudullah defends it towards mid on.

DRINKS BREAK. Bangladesh are slightly losing the plot now. Even at this stage, they are almost on par with Australia. The Kangaroos were 186 at this point of time, but with just a wicket down. It is from here that the explosion started. The Tigers will hope that they don't have an implosion instead.
Tossed up on off, Mahmudullah chips it over the bowler's head. Cummins runs to his right from long off and stops it with a dive. He pushes it to his partner who comes in from long on. A run taken.
Short on middle and off, Mushfiqur pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter on middle, Mahmudullah milks it down to long on for one.
Play and miss. Flighted leg spinner outside off, it does not spin much. Mahmudullah looks to drive but misses.
On middle, Rahim flicks it to deep mid-wicket and gets a single.
Beauty. Leg spinner pitching on off, Mushfiqur looks to defend but misses it due to the away spin.
Length ball on middle, Mahmudullah blocks it to see off the over. 202 needed off 114 balls.
On the stumps now, Mahmudullah defends it back to the bowler.
Outside off and full, Mushfiqur drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
Back of a length ball on the body, Mahmudullah pulls it wide of fine leg. There were shouts of catch it but only Superman had a chance of taking that.
Full on off, Rahim flat-bats it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Good length ball on off, Mushfiqur defends it towards point.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
On middle and leg, tucked through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, Rahim looks to push but misses.
Drives this through the covers for a single.
Mahmudullah is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Zampa gets Australia the breakthrough. It was the slider, pitching outside off and Das misses the flick, with the ball hitting the pad. Zampa appeals, umpire Gough thinks for a while and then raises his finger! Das has a look at Rahim, then walks over for a chat. Rahim smiles and then agrees for the review. Replays show that there was no inside edge with the bat being behind the pad. Ball Tracker shows it to be clipping the leg stump. So Bangladesh do not lose a review but lose Das.

Is that the first wicket for Zampa? Liton Das has been adjudged leg before. He has a long chat with Rahim and after a wry smile, they decide to refer it upstairs. No inside edge. Is this sliding down? No. Umpire's call it is, clipping leg stump.
Full and a bit outside off, played back to the bowler.
Adam Zampa is back! 4-0-29-0 his figures so far.
Full on off, Rahim defends it off the front foot to see off the over.
Outside off, Mushfiqur drives it to the man at point.
Back of a length ball on off, Liton pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for a run.
On the pads, Liton follows the boundary with a flick which is wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Liton is not going to die trying. Back of a length ball on off, Das pulls it over short mid-wicket and gets a boundary.
Full on off, Rahim pushes it towards cover and gets a single.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is back!
FOUR! Poor from Stoinis in the deep. Full on off, Liton drives it wide of sweeper cover. Stoinis runs to his right but slips and the ball goes away to the fence.
On the pads, Liton flicks it but finds mid-wicket.
FOUR! Oh, gorgeous on drive. On off and on a length, Liton gets on his front foot and drives it handsomely through mid on for a boundary.
Outside off, Mushfiqur runs it down to third man for a single.
On off, Mushfiqur defends it to cover.
Good length ball on the pads, Liton nudges it down to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Gorgeous cover drive. Overpitched on off, Mushfiqur gets on his front foot and drives it through covers for a beautiful boundary.
Short ball on off, Liton pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
On the pads, Mushfiqur glances it to fine leg and rotates the strike.
Once again looks to run it down past third man but finds the fielder there.
Oh, almost chopped on. Back of a length outside off, Liton looks to pull but gets an inside edge which goes past the stumps towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Mushfiqur runs it down to third man and gets a single.
On the pads, Mushfiqur flicks it to fine leg and keeps the strike.
Outside off, Rahim looks to guide it past short third man but ends up finding him.
On off, Liton drives it towards cover and takes a run.
Outside off, Liton pushes it to point.
In the air but safe. Full outside off, Rahim frees his arm and looks to hit it over cover but he gets an outside edge which goes to third man on a bounce and they take a run.
Good length ball on off, Rahim pushes it to cover.
Pat Cummins is back!
Outside off, LD runs it down to point but does not get a single.
Good length ball on the stumps, Das taps it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, Mushfiqur drives it wide of cover for a single.
On the pads, Liton flicks it to deep mid-wicket and gets a single.

The physio is out in the middle having a check on Liton. He looks to be fine but you cannot take any risk with such incidents. He will need a new helmet and the physio is having a concussion test on him.
Nasty! Bouncer on middle, Liton looks to duck but he is late and the ball rattles his helmet. Starc has a check on Liton and Das gives him a thumbs up, indicating he is alright.
Liton Das is the new man in.

OUT! Chopped on. Tamim does not convert his fifty and Bangladesh in deep waters here. Good length ball outside off, Tamim looks to guide it down towards third man but he ends up getting an inside edge as his feet went nowhere near the ball. The ball goes onto hit the leg pole. Starc is having fun, he keeps his hand on his mouth and smiles looking at Tamim. Maybe even he knows it was not a ball which deserved a wicket. He will take it though as he now becomes the highest wicket-taker in  this World Cup.
Down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a well-run couple.
WIDE. Tossed up outside off, Rahim lets it go. Wide signalled.
Outside off, Mushfiqur pushes it towards point, sets off for a single but is sent back.
On middle and leg, tucked through square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.

FOUR! Nicely played. Finally a shot in anger. Tamim shuffles towards off, Zampa  bowls a fuller delivery onto middle, Tamim goes for a slog sweep and is successful in hitting this one for a boundary as it lands safely near mid-wicket.
Zampa bowls a flatter one this time, outside off. Rahim cuts it towards covers for a single.

Brute of a bouncer. It is on the body, Mushfiqur looks to get away from it but he is too late. The ball hits his glove and lobs up towards third man. It falls short of the fielder there and they get a single.

Poor from Khawaja. Full on off, Tamim drives it hard towards cover. Khawaja misfields there and the ball goes past him. Substitute Lyon runs behind it and stops it before the ropes with a dive. The batsmen take 3. Good fielding from Garry. Saves a run for his side.
In the air but safe. Length ball outside off, Rahim hits it uppishly towards third man for a single.

Once again there is a lack of communication. Good length ball on the pads, Mushfiqur looks to flick but misses. The ball hits his pad and goes towards the third man region. Rahim comes out for a single but Tamim is not interested and sends him back. Carey has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
Length ball on middle, Mushfiqur defends it back to the bowler.
Good length ball outside off, Tamim punches it towards mid off. The fielder is at the edge of the circle, meaning they get the single with ease.
Mitchell Starc is back for another burst. 3-0-15-0 his figures so far.
Landed outside off, Mushfiqur comes down the track but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Pushes it to the off side.

SIX! Up and over! Finally it arrives. The first six in a run chase of 382. A full toss onto the leg stump, Rahim races down the track and thrashes into the stands at long on. Easy pickings for Rahim and much-needed one for  Bangladesh.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for a run.
A yorker length delivery onto off, Rahim drives it back to the bowler but wait, the ball goes between Zampa's legs and the batsmen take a single. Lethargic.
Pushes this straight to cover.
A bit short and quick, Tamim goes on the back foot and punches it to the mid off fielder. A single taken.
Stoinis is a lucky man. He serves a full toss on the body, Tamim does not make the most of it and he just glances it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle, Mushfiqur flicks it to deep mid-wicket and gets to the other end.

FIFTY FOR TAMIM! His first fifty in this World Cup. Good length ball outside off, Tamim taps it down to third man and gets a single to bring up his 47th ODI fifty. He holds the key here in this chase. He needs to convert this into a daddy hundred if Bangladesh wants to keep their hopes alive in this tournament.
FOUR! Nicely pulled! Tamim moves to 49! Slower bouncer on the body, Tamim pulls it over mid-wicket and gets a boundary.
Full again on middle and leg, Tamim pushes it back to the bowler.
Full on middle, Mushfiqur flicks it to deep mid-wicket and gets a single.
Full and outside middle, sweeps this through fine leg for a run.
Zampa bowls a fuller length, Rahim comes forward and plays a solid defense, ball goes rolling back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Rahim looks to defend but gets a bottom edge which is stopped by Carey on the bounce.
IN THE AIR, SAFE! Full and outside off, Rahim pushes this with a loose bottom hand and it almost goes back to the bowler. Lands just short.

FOUR! Fine shot. Bangladesh need to attack Zampa and not let him settle. Full and around off, Rahim gets down, brings out his reverse sweep and connects it really well to send it over short third man.
Again a tossed delivery onto leg, Rahim goes for a paddle and works it towards fine leg to grab a pair.

Good length ball on middle, Rahim flicks it to square leg and gets a single. Brilliant over from Stoinis. Just shows how critical he is for this side. He gives away just three runs and gets the prized scalp of Shakib Al Hasan.
On the pads, Iqbal flicks it to the on side and gets a single.
On the stumps, Tamim defends it with a straight bat.
On the pads, Mushfiqur turns it behind square on the leg side and takes a single.
Good length ball on middle, Mushfiqur defends it off the front foot.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks out to bat next. Bangladesh need a world class innings from him today.

OUT! The slower one does the trick and the Bangla superstar is out of here. It is on middle and leg, Shakib looks to flick but gets deceived by the lack of pace on it. He ends up chipping his flick which goes straight to the man at mid off. You just cannot keep Warner out of this game. He is the one stationed out there, he gets down and takes a good catch. Body blow this for Bangladesh. This is a tough ask and without Shakib this looks close to impossible. Shakib will be disappointed with this dismissal. It was not the best of deliveries and he might feel he could have done better.
Tossed delivery onto the leg stump, much fuller this time, batsman works this towards square leg for a single to end the over.
Full and outside leg, flicked through mid-wicket for one more.
Shorter one and onto the pads, Shakib flicks it towards square leg and grabs a single.
A touch short, the wrong 'un again, Tamim walks across and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Around middle, watchfully defended.
Googly to start his day, a bit quicker, Tamim goes for the defence and is beaten.
Adam Zampa is brought on to bowl now.

DRINKS BREAK. A look at the scorecard and it might suggest that Bangladesh are nowhere in this run chase. They need 284 from 198 balls at 8.6 an over and one may think, impossible. But consider this - Australia were 101/0 at this stage. So, nothing much to choose between the two. Bangladesh just have to figure out how to counter Usman Khawaja's attack. There is nothing in the pitch, the ball is not moving and the ground is way too small. Decent partnerships will keep them in the hunt and that one mad knock can probably cause the unthinkable.
Single to end the over. Back of a length on off, Tamim pulls it to deep mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Length ball on off, Shakib milks it down to long off for one.
Good length ball on the pads, Tamim flicks it to square leg and takes a single.
Once again on the stumps, Tamim blocks it.

Almost another run out. Good length ball on off, Tamim defends it and looks for a quick single. Shakib comes but then Tamim sends him back as he slips in his stride out. Smith gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. It would have been close had Steve hit the target but I feel that Shakib would have been in.
FOUR! Cut away! Stoinis bowls it wide outside off, Tamim cuts it past of the diving Maxwell at point for a boundary. Good start to over this for Bangladesh.
Once again Nathan bowls it on the body, Tamim flicks it to deep mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Bouncer! It is away from the body so Shakib pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
On middle and leg, Tamim flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off on a length, Shakib guides it down to third man for a run.
On the pads, Tamim flicks it to square leg and gets a single.
Coulter-Nile bangs it in short. Tamim plays a very controlled pull wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.

By the way, just missed that Marcus Stoinis was called into the attack. Nothing special about that over but Finch will be happy that he has got one extra bowling option. His absence has really hurt the Aussies in the bowling department and his 5-6 overs can take some pressure off the regular bowlers.
Down the leg side, helped through fine leg for one more.
Full and around middle, driven straight back down the ground for a run.
Full and around middle, sensibly flicked through mid-wicket for another single.
Around middle, tucked through square leg for one more.
Dropped short, Tamim launches into the pull but the ball rises high on him and he mistimes it in the air, but wide of mid on. A single taken.
Around off, tapped to the off side for a quick single.
A full toss on the pads, whipped through mid-wicket for one.
Around middle, defended back to the bowler.
A short ball again, around middle and leg, TI goes for the hook but is cramped for room. The ball takes the inside edge and goes fine down the leg side. A quick run taken.
A bouncer, on middle, Tamim ducks. It bounces way too high and Iqbal looks at the square leg umpire for the wide signal but it does not come.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
Around off, solidly defended.
On the pads again, Shakib flicks it towards square leg and gets a single.
This time flicks it wide of mid-wicket and gets a couple. It also brings up the 50-run stand between the two.
On the pads, Shakib flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Two in two and this is even better. Tossed up on middle, Shakib lofts it over the bowler's head and scores another boundary.
FOUR! Very well played. Flighted on off, Shakib comes down the track and chips it wide of long on. Nathan Coulter-Nile runs to his right to stop it but fails in his attempt to do so.
Flighted around off, Tamim plays it towards point and takes a single.
Single to end the over. Back of a length ball on off, Tamim defends it with soft hands and takes a run.
Outside off on a length, Shakib punches it through covers for one.
Length ball on off, Tamim looks to play it on the off side but gets an inside edge. The ball goes down the leg side and they take a single.
Good length ball around off, Tamim looks to defend but does so off the upper half of the bat. The ball bounces down the ground but on the side of the stumps.
Short again, this time Shakib pulls it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
BOUNCER! Shakib ducks under it and lets it carry to the keeper.
Outside off, Iqbal drives it to the man at point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On the pads, Shakib flicks it to mid-wicket and takes one.
In the air but safe. Outside off, Shakib looks to hit it over covers but gets an outside edge which goes over point and they take a couple.
Short outside off, Shakib drives it through covers and takes a couple. Cummins in the deep cleans it up. He slips but no damage done.
Good running. Tossed up on the pads, Tamim defends it towards the on side and takes a quick single.

Powerplay 2 signalled. Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. As Australia have always shown in this tournament, as soon as Powerplay 1 is done, they introduce a spinner. This time, they are not introducing, as Glenn Maxwell has already bowled an over before. Here he comes again.
Short again, Shakib pulls it to short mid-wicket. That ends Powerplay 1, with Bangladesh making 53/1. Australia were 53/0 at this stage.
FOUR! Slower ball gone wrong. Full on off, Shakib drives it magnificently past mid off and the ball races away to the fence. This man is in some kind of form.
Short now. Shakib pulls it to mid-wicket off the upper half of his bat.
Yorker! It is on off, Shakib does well to get his bat down in time.
Good length ball on off, Shakib punches it to cover.
Good length ball around off, Shakib pushes it to the man at cover.
Stifled appeal turned down. Good length ball pitching outside leg, Shakib looks to flick but it goes off his pad towards the fine leg region and they take a single
FOUR! Smashed! Outside off on a length. Shakib the form that he is in, will take the width on offer with both hands and smashes his cut over point for a boundary.
Full on off, Shakib drives it through mid off and gets a couple.
Outside off,  Iqbal looks to cut but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
This time it is full, and Iqbal defends it off the front foot.
On a length on off, Iqbal punches it to the man at cover.
Short ball on middle and leg, Tamim pulls it towards mid on.

SAFE! Waste of a review. It looked to be pitching outside leg and that was the issue. Good length ball around leg, Shakib looks to flick but misses. The Australian players put in an appeal. The umpire though turns it down. Finch has a word with the keeper, NCN was not too convinced but Carey gives the green light for the review. They take it upstairs, Ultra Edge shows no inside edge. Ball Tracker later shows the ball was pitching outside leg.

Review time! Coulter-Nile and Carey reckon that Shakib is plumb in front. Looks to be pitched outside leg though. A gamble by Finch and he takes it. Could be a big wicket if Shakib is dismissed. Well, Ball Tracker shows it to be pitching outside leg. Matter over.

Outside off on a length, Tamim shuffles across and taps it down to third man. Maxwell moves to his right and looks to have a shy even before getting a grip of the ball. He misses and then slips later on. Allows them to take an easy single.
Good length ball on middle, Tamim looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads. There was a stifled appeal but the umpire is not interested at all.
On top of off, Tamim defends it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off now, Shakib taps it towards deep point and gets a single.
WIDE! Starts with a wide down the leg side. Shakib leaves it alone and it has been wided.
Nathan Coulter-Nile into the attack. 4 bowlers already used by Finch inside Powerplay 1.
SHOT! Very well played this. Length ball outside off, Tamim guides it past the diving point fielder. Zampa from third man cleans it up as the batsmen take two.
Bouncer! It is around the body, Tamim sits under it. He has had issues with the short ball in the past.
Good length ball on off, Tamim punches it to cover.
In the air but safe. Full outside off, Tamim looks to play it on the on side but it goes off the upper half of his bat. It is short of mid on so no worry there.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Loose start. Full and on the pads, Tamim flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a boundary!
Change of ends for Cummins.
Outside off, Tamim guides it down to the right of short third man. Starc there dives to that side and saves a certain boundary. Only a single taken.

OUCH! That must have hurt. Flighted on off, Tamim pushes it to cover and looks for a quick single but he is sent back. The fielder gets to the ball and throws it to the keeper. The ball hits Tamim on his right calf and he slips down. The Aussies get around him and just try to cheer him up.
Flighted on off, Shakib milks it down towards cover and takes a single.
Good running. On off, Tamim pushes it towards cover and takes a quick single.
Floated on off, Tamim defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Not the welcome Maxwell would have been looking for. Tossed up on off, Tamim gets on the front foot and creams it through covers for a boundary.
Spin inside Powerplay 1. It is going to be Glenn Maxwell.
A bouncer on middle, Shakib ducks.
On middle and leg, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
A bouncer on middle, Tamim is on his back side as he looks to duck.
Around off, pushed to the off side for a single. The throw is a wild one, going towards long off and Shakib wants the second but Tamim has backed up too far and hence the run is cancelled.

That goes through everything! On a length outside off, cutting back in sharply, Shakib looks to defend but the ball comes back in a long way, cuts him into half and just misses the off stump on height!
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Bouncer to end the over! Tamim sits under it.

Shakib Al Hasan walks out at number 3. It was his heroics in the last game that saw Bangladesh chase down the 300-plus total with ease. The ask is even bigger this time and he will have to be the savior once again.

OUT! Disaster, Disaster! This is just school boy stuff. No communication at all. Good length ball on middle, Tamim flicks it towards mid on and looks for a single. He comes halfway down the track but Sarkar sends him back. And for some reason after sending his partner back Sarkar goes to the keeper's end. Finch slides to his right and stops the ball. Finch shows his alertness and after deciding to throw it at the keeper's end he waits and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Sarkar is in middle of nowhere and has to walk back. This is just the kind of start you don't want while chasing a mammoth total.
Bouncer! Tamim ducks under it.
On off, Iqbal blocks it off the back foot.

FOUR BYES! The ball swings and dips but after it goes past the stumps. You don't want that kind of a swing, especially if you are a keeper. Good length ball outside off, Iqbal looks to defend but misses. The ball moves away and Carey behind misses it due to the movement.
Good length ball on off, Iqbal pushes it to cover.
Better this. Good length ball outside off, Sarkar looks to cut but misses. 10 from the over, Bangladesh are on the march.

FOUR! This is an even worse ball than the previous one. Full toss on the pads, Sarkar flicks it down the fine leg region. Cummins runs to his left and gets to the ball  but he slips and the ball deflects off him to the fence.
FOUR! Poor ball this from Starc. He gets no swing and he bowls it on the pads. Sarkar just uses the pace of the ball and flicks it over square leg. The outfield is quick and he gets a boundary.
On middle and leg and coming in with the angle. Tamim turns it towards square leg and gets a single.
Good length ball on off, Tamim pushes it to mid off.
Good length ball which comes in with the angle. It is on the pads, Sarkar looks to flick but misses. The ball goes down to the fine leg region and they take a leg bye.
Dot to finish the over. Once again it is on a length, Tamim punches it to cover-point to see off the over.
Follows it up with a punch to cover.

FOUR! First one of the innings and what a handsome looking stroke this is. Cummins bowls it too full on off, Tamim just strides out his front foot and drives it with class through mid off for a boundary.
Length ball on off, Tamim defends it off the back foot.

In the air...but safe. Good length ball outside off, Sarkar checks his shot and ends up chipping it wide of mid off. Warner slips there to his right and looks to block the ball from hitting his face. In an attempt to do so, he stops the ball as well, that too, with his wrong hand, the left. so just a single. In the end it is a good effort from David. Everyone is smiles. Cummins applauds the effort.
No swing for Cummins either. Full on off, Sarkar pushes it to mid off.
Pat Cummins to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Good length ball on off, Iqbal defends it to the man at cover.
Sarkar is off the mark. Good length ball angling away from the batsman slightly, Soumya looks to defend but gets an outside edge which goes to third man. Sarkar takes a single.
Outside off on a length, Sarkar plays it to the man at point.

The chase is off the mark. Good length ball outside off, Tamim stays tall and punches it between mid off and cover. Warner at mid off slips but Stoinis from cover runs behind the ball and pulls it before the ropes. 3 taken by the batsmen.
Full on middle and off, Iqbal blocks it off the front foot.
Starts with a good length ball on middle, Tamim jumps and tucks it to mid-wicket. Absolutely no movement there.

We are back for the chase! The Australian players are out and going to their respective position in the field. Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar walk out to start this daunting chase. The first new ball is in the hands of Mitchell Starc. He will start the proceedings. He has two slips in place to begin. Also, it is drizzling.
